text.en:
Today you learn to ask with a first word.
Where do you work?
It means: in which place?
When does the sale end?
It means: at what time?

Put the question word first.
Then Do or Does, then the rest.
What size do you wear?
Why does the alarm beep?
How much does a ticket cost?
With Who, you skip Do and Does.
Who checks the orders?

You will pick the right first word.
Where is a place. When is a time.
What and Which pick a thing. Why asks the reason.
How asks the way. How many asks a number.
How many people live here?
How do I restart the printer?
